limitations: Rain feature uses KETINGGIAN_TERAKHIR as an uncalibrated source signal. It is NOT claimed as hourly rainfall mm.
Source DATETIME timezone must be confirmed. Timestamps retained as source wall-clock.
Station pairing uses nearest rain gauge within 10 km as exploratory fallback, not verified hydrological connectivity.
Hourly mean follows deduplication by station and observation time. Conflicting duplicates are excluded.
Missing hours are excluded, never filled with zero. Complete 6-hour rain history is required.
Report association within 5 km and 6 hours is temporal-spatial evidence only, not independent flood verification. Absence of reports is not a non-flood label.
Single chronological holdout, no operational release, no calibrated flood probabilities.
